## Checklist

- [ ] It fits the scope of this list: securing and reviewing GitHub Actions workflows and CI/CD pipelines
- [ ] It is not already in the list
- [ ] Description starts with a capital letter, ends with a period and does not start with the item's name
- [ ] The link works and is the canonical project page
- [ ] The project is maintained, or is a historically important reference
- [ ] I checked that the repository owner and name match the project's own documentation, and the link has no shortener or tracking parameters
- [ ] `python scripts/check_readme.py` passes
